title: A sphere resting on a plane
shows: A 10 mm glass bead dropped on the floor settles where its Hertzian contact force k·δ^(3/2) carries its weight: it sinks δ = (m·g/k)^(2/3) = 25.45 µm.
source: Hertz's contact law: K. L. Johnson, Contact Mechanics (1985), §4.2.

checks.what: how far it sinks, as a share of Hertz's
